title: Automate changelog and onboard Cypher-13B-v1.0 (perf profiles + metadata)
author: Maya Patel
description:
Context and motivation: We are onboarding a community-contributed model 'Cypher-13B-v1.0' into the registry with curated performance profiles and fully-automated changelog/release note generation. This PR adds model metadata, quantization and kernel recommendations, target perf profiles for our standard sequences, and wiring for the changelog automation so model releases produce a human-readable release note in the registry UI.

What this PR does: 1) Adds models/cypher-13b/v1.0/metadata.yaml containing canonical metadata (architecture, tokenizer, recommended quantization profiles, known limitations, and security guidance). 2) Adds perf profiles under perf/cypher-13b/v1.0/ with 4 workload slices (low-latency chat, completion-512, batch-1024, embeddings) and measured median p95 token latency across tested hardware. 3) Integrates the model into the existing changelog automation: CI job that validates metadata and auto-generates release_notes markdown which is stored in registry metadata and surfaced in the Console. 4) Adds small docs and an example quickstart that shows recommended API params for cost vs latency tradeoffs.

Testing and validation: Perf profiles were generated using the benchmark-lab harness (benchmarks attached to the PR artifacts). CI includes metadata/schema validation, perf sanity check (no regressions vs baseline thresholds), and docs build. Manual review: perf numbers were spot-checked on a p4d-like testbed and aT4 cluster.

Rollout plan: Merged to main with squash-merge after approvals. Changelog automation will publish the release note for Cypher-13B-v1.0 as part of the model registry ingestion workflow. No runtime changes required for serving; changes are metadata-only and safe to roll out.

Follow-ups: 1) Add additional quantization presets for OVX hardware (ENG-4902). 2) Add E2E canary profile for Canary jobs that exercise streaming (PM-938).

References: Linear ENG-4821, PM-921; incident SUP-3321 (support asked for a model with better small-batch perf guidance).
